articles.summary: BURLINGTON, N.J., May 14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Burlington Stores, Inc. (NYSE: BURL), a nationally recognized off-price retailer of high-quality, branded apparel, footwear, accessories, and merchandise for the home at everyday low prices, will release its first quarter fiscal year 2026 results
articles.title: Burlington Stores, Inc. Announces First Quarter Fiscal Year 2026 Earnings Release Date, Conference Call and Webcast

articles.summary: Total sales increased 14%, on top of 6% last year Comparable store sales increased 6% Net income was $115 million, and diluted EPS was $1.79 Excluding certain expenses associated with bankruptcy acquired leases: Adjusted EPS increased 26% to $2.10, well above guidance Full year adjusted EPS
articles.title: BURLINGTON STORES REPORTS STRONG FIRST QUARTER SALES AND EARNINGS GROWTH, WELL AHEAD OF GUIDANCE. THIS REPRESENTS THE 14TH CONSECUTIVE QUARTER OF DOUBLE DIGIT EPS GROWTH.
